scope: Backend typed output validation and repository decision guard
behavior: Reject coerced integer fields, invalid known-field types and unrecognised verdicts
Reject duplicate single-result records and duplicate segment/option/paragraph identifiers
Reject overview references outside the local paragraph count
Preserve the entire raw reply; invalid replies expose no actionable edits
Repository rejects decision updates for invalid structured reviews and preserves existing content/state
Keep minimal legacy shapes and unknown extension types/fields compatible

after_fix.android_default_isolated_suite: PASS including the same 82 protocol cases, invalid-decision preservation and all previous atomic exchange/rapid update/backup/migration checks

limits: Schema validation does not measure factual correction quality or prove quotations exist in a supplied source
Known fields are validated; unknown extension types/fields are deliberately retained as compatible
JSONObject syntax compatibility and complete response-section counts are not a strict JSON Schema implementation
